outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of fluorescence micrographs only; no quantitative plot is shown.

Panel B includes two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing group means with error bars (n=20 stated in caption), but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a Western blot image, not a quantitative plot.
Panel D contains bar charts of SDH and COX signal intensity across genotypes with error bars and sample sizes (n) indicated, but individual data points are not shown on the bars.

Panel E shows FACS histograms (cell counts vs. TMRM intensity) for individual replicate experiments; these are distribution plots analogous to histograms/line plots and do not require overlaid individual data points.
